status: 0.79.13 OPEN: own scanout allocation and paired Window/Core submission integrated; T1-T6/A1-A2 remain open
scope: Explicit internal Device/GSP API. Contiguous native RGB scanout allocation, retained typed image contexts, C67E window methods and paired core/window completion. Common Present and safe mode adoption are not connected yet; passive bootfb remains default.

facts.allocation: allocateDisplaySurface creates an actual common native BO with scanout+transfer-target usage, validated RGB linear geometry, RM clearing/contiguity and physical extent bounds. Its retained display Use survives creator close. Published table entries bind immutable surface geometry and native storage; caller-supplied addresses are not accepted.
facts.methods: C67E: mono non-tearing interval1, size/pitch/format, all six eye/plane contexts and offsets, unused pitches zero, unscaled input/output, horizontal and vertical TAPS_2, scan direction, disabled acquire/release semaphore contexts. Initial state bypasses input LUT/CSC and installs identity FMT plus opaque primary composition. Window methods interlock with the matching core window-owner UPDATE.
facts.submission: The serialized Device worker publishes window PUT before core PUT and then waits for both completion conditions. Actual owner, root, table, image, route, deadline, offset and command bytes authorize MMIO. Preparing a new core work item uses a local result before publishing the optional work owner, avoiding premature Busy from Zig result-location semantics.
facts.completion: Core requires FINISHED; Window requires BEGUN. GET alone and either half alone do not publish ActiveDisplayImage. Windows alternate two 16-byte notifier records; a previously used record is reusable only after FINISHED. A prematurely FINISHED new record is rejected because no other producer may supersede it. Timestamp reads use stable status and CPU fences.
facts.lifecycle: Monotone ring points continue from retained notifier state on channel recreation. Channel Free plus physical deallocation releases command buffers only. Instance/table/notifiers and native image allocations remain retained until a future physical transition owner proves retirement. Queued GSP faults precede completion; timeout/error retains the in-flight pair and all reachable storage.

validation.reference: 984-byte fixture compiled from original C67D/C67E/C37B headers and Nouveau DRF macros: routed core init/repeat and XRGB/ARGB window init/repeat, including offset16 and nonzero image origin. Existing transport group compares every word and invalid field/extent rejection. Eleven complete original files/notices archived.
validation.device: Four scenarios added to the existing actual Device test: three paired image submissions with two-record reuse guard; window timeout after core completion; already queued firmware fault before Window BEGUN; premature Window FINISHED. Includes actual native allocation/creator close, table CE upload, both channel allocations, command admission, retained geometry tamper rejection and physical command retirement.
validation.guest: No unchanged QEMU rerun; Kernel/Contract/SDK/common queues unchanged.
validation.limits: Host model and independent reference bytes establish software behavior only. No physical GPU execution, visible image, HDMI sound or mode adoption was tested.

sources.fixture: Original C67D/C67E/C37B/507C class definitions and Nouveau DRF macros, no Zig encoder linked.

attribution.notice_normalization: Added trailing whitespace only; all prior license bytes preserved
